nodes.label: Deprecation and Migration
nodes.rationale: Code is a liability, not an asset. Deprecation = removing code that no longer earns its keep; migration = moving users safely from old to new. Deprecation planning starts at design time.

nodes.label: Expand/Contract Schema Migration
nodes.rationale: Never change a column in place. Expand (add nullable column) → Migrate (dual-write + backfill in batches) → Contract (drop old column in separate deploy). Each step independently deployable and reversible.

nodes.label: Strangler Pattern
nodes.rationale: Run old and new systems in parallel; route traffic incrementally from old to new (0%→10%→50%→100%); remove old system at 0% traffic.
